label: Technique Murray 2: a 2 ft wind sea down the course

test.title: Murray 2: a 2 ft wind sea down the course
test.purpose: The same in a smaller, shorter sea (3.3 s, 17 m waves): the faces are closer together and pass faster. Murray Stewart's cues (Rottnest camp, November 2026): catch a wave, as square as needed; stay high on its face (ease off, let the push hold you); scan 3 to 8 m ahead of the bow, within 30 degrees either side, for darker patches on the back faces ahead; when one is in reach, sprint to drop and move to it, to be on the upper part of the next wave's face there; prefer running diagonal to square.
lookFor: the dark patches 3 to 8 m ahead: one wave ahead or two?
how quickly a drop has to follow the cue
questions: Is the cue easier or harder to use than in the 3 ft sea?
Does diagonal running help more here (the crests run at 11.6 mph)?
